verdict.rationale: Paperspace gives root SSH access and API/CLI control over VMs and storage (paperspace-docs-12, paperspace-docs-19, paperspace-docs-24, paperspace-docs-30), which lets a technical user manually copy data off machines/notebooks, but there is no documented bulk 'export my data' feature, data-portability guarantee, or open-format export commitment. Missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, guarantee of open non-proprietary formats for notebooks/models/deployments, and any first-party or community confirmation of a smooth 'leave with your data' workflow.
